instruction: What is my longest limited-screen-time-to-1-hr habit streak, in number of days, as per my Simple Note habit tracking logs?
notes: Read-only information task (evaluation requires no database changes), so only lookup APIs are used. The habit tracking logs are modeled as two Simple Note notes returned by a single search_notes call (predicate found-by/search-done instead of one known-id per search call, so one search lists all logs). Each show_note reveals a log; the answer object longest-streak-days is a runtime value the agent computes after reading every log (max consecutive days marked done). supervisor-complete-task takes the answer plus the two distinct habit-log notes as non-API parameters so that its precondition mirrors the goal (both logs read, streak known); if the search returns more habit log notes, add note objects/params accordingly. Login username is the supervisor's email; the simple_note password comes from show_account_passwords.
